Describe what you expected and what happened instead.

**Setup**

- Project Memory version (`project-memory-mcp --version`), or Studio version:
- Operating system and CPU architecture:
- AI client and version, if relevant:
- Component: MCP server / skill / helper / Studio

**Steps to reproduce**

Use the smallest example you can, preferably a new project with synthetic notes.
Include the tool name or command, expected result, and actual error.

**Relevant output**

Paste a short, redacted error or diagnostic result. Do not upload your archive,
backups, saved project text, credentials or private filesystem paths. A past
successful check is useful context, but include what happens on this version.

See the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/CharlieJamesGwapo/project-memory-mcp/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md).
Report security vulnerabilities privately using [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/CharlieJamesGwapo/project-memory-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
